response.sql: WITH signed_transactions AS (SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency, CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type IN ('VYDAJ', 'VYBER') THEN -t.amount ELSE NULL END as signed_amount, t.balance FROM trans t INNER JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id), account_averages AS (SELECT account_id, frequency, AVG(CASE WHEN signed_amount IS NOT NULL THEN signed_amount END) as avg_signed_amount, AVG(balance) as avg_balance FROM signed_transactions GROUP BY account_id, frequency), frequency_averages AS (SELECT frequency, AVG(avg_signed_amount) as freq_avg_signed_amount, AVG(avg_balance) as freq_avg_balance FROM account_averages GROUP BY frequency), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(freq_avg_signed_amount) as mean_signed_amount FROM frequency_averages), filtered_frequencies AS (SELECT f.frequency, f.freq_avg_signed_amount, f.freq_avg_balance, o.mean_signed_amount FROM frequency_averages f CROSS JOIN overall_mean o WHERE f.freq_avg_signed_amount > o.mean_signed_amount) SELECT AVG(freq_avg_signed_amount) as avg_of_avg_signed_amounts, AVG(freq_avg_balance) as avg_of_avg_balances, AVG(freq_avg_signed_amount - mean_signed_amount) as avg_excess_over_mean FROM filtered_frequencies;
